The item looks clean and is next to a crate, but there is no proof of its history or internal condition.

risks.risk: The windings may be aluminum or copper-clad aluminum instead of 100% copper.
risks.proof: A technical specification sheet or a video showing the internal windings through the vents.

risks.risk: The unit may have internal electrical faults or fail to produce the rated voltage.
risks.proof: A video of the alternator running under load with a multimeter showing the output.

proof_requests: A sharp, readable close-up photo of the metal nameplate on the side of the alternator.
A photo of the internal windings visible through the side cooling vents.
A video of the alternator coupled to an engine and generating power.
response.reason: The kVA rating, which is the primary factor for pricing this item, cannot be read from the provided photo.
